---
title: "Sound source dominance"
description: "Mean dominance of each sound source, by location."
date: 2026-01-17
categories: [sound sources, seaborn]
---

```{python}
#| label: fig-source-dominance
#| fig-alt: "Mean sound source dominance by location"
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns

data = pd.read_csv("../../assets/DemoData.csv")

sources = ["traffic_noise", "other_noise", "human_sounds", "natural_sounds"]
long = (
    data.groupby("LocationID")[sources]
    .mean()
    .reset_index()
    .melt(id_vars="LocationID", var_name="Source", value_name="Dominance")
)

sns.barplot(data=long, x="Source", y="Dominance", hue="LocationID", palette="colorblind")
plt.title("Sound source dominance by location")
plt.ylabel("Mean dominance rating")
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
